text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russia is holding talks with Iraq to sign oil deals.
- Italy to open interest section in Iraq soon.
- Iraq and Turkey are conducting trade talks in Ankara.
- Iraq's Trade Minister says in Amman the oil-for-food deal will be implemented soon.
(The above stories were carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Iraqi ports at the Gulf are ready to receive vessels loaded with medicine and foodstuffs.
